symbols.name: number of places
symbols.meaning: The number of places in the system, a positive integer.
symbols.quote: Fix a number $\beta$ of places, a positive integer, and lengths $\lambda_1, \dots, \lambda_\beta$, each a positive integer.

symbols.name: place length
symbols.meaning: The length of place j, a count of the values that the digit at place j can take.
symbols.quote: Here $\lambda_j$ is the length of place $j$, the number of values its digit can take.

symbols.name: place index
symbols.meaning: An index naming one place of the system, running from 1 to beta; on this page it is not the index of earlier pages.
symbols.quote: The place index $j$ runs from $1$ to $\beta$ and names a place; on this page it does not carry the meaning of the index on earlier pages.

symbols.name: total length
symbols.meaning: The product of all place lengths, which counts the distinct digit strings the system can write.
symbols.quote: Let $\Lambda = \lambda_1\lambda_2\cdots\lambda_\beta$ be the product of the lengths, the number of distinct digit strings the system can write.

symbols.name: place value
symbols.meaning: The weight of place j, the product of the lengths of the places below it.
symbols.quote: The place value of place $j$ is $w_j = \lambda_1\lambda_2\cdots\lambda_{j-1}$, the product of the lengths of the places below it, with $w_1 = 1$.

symbols.name: integer being written
symbols.meaning: The integer whose mixed-radix expansion is sought, with 0 at most nu less than Lambda.
symbols.quote: Let $\nu$ be an integer with $0 \le \nu < \Lambda$, the integer being written.

symbols.name: digit
symbols.meaning: The digit of nu at place j, an integer from 0 to lambda_j minus 1.
symbols.quote: The digit $e_j$ at place $j$ is an integer with $0 \le e_j < \lambda_j$, the digit of the expansion at that place.
